fullBoardAndHalfBoard_perPersonPerNight.halfBoardReduction: US$9 per person per night off the Full Board figures above

groundPackageRates_perPersonPerNight.unit: First Night / Extra Nights / SRS (single room supplement)
groundPackageRates_perPersonPerNight.includes: Full-board accommodation, return airstrip transfers, 2 game drives per day

circuitDiscount.raw: Groups/series staying at Eka Hotel & Ol Tukai enjoy a further discount: Eka Hotel 5%, Ol Tukai 5%

childPolicy_fullBoardHalfBoard.raw: 0-1.99yrs infant; 2-11.99yrs child; 12+ adult. One child in single room: single rate. Two children in a room: single rate. Three children: single + child rate. Four children: full twin rate. One adult+one child: single + child sharing. One adult+two children: full twin rate. One adult+three children: twin + child sharing. Two adults+one child: twin + child sharing rate (50% of an adult in double).

seasonalSupplementsAndExtras.item: Tour Leader's rate (only if accompanying group of min 4 pax)

policies.payment: With credit facilities: full payment within 30 days of invoice. Without: full payment at least 60 days before accommodation date.
policies.invoiceDispute: Must be raised within 14 days of invoice receipt
policies.complimentaryTourLeader: 1 room per 15 paying persons, pre-booked and confirmed
policies.cancellation: Booking date to 61 days prior: 20% fee; 60-31 days: 50% fee; within 30 days: 100% fee. Additional fees may apply for cancelled flights/other services.
